description: `stages[0]` = in-situ geostatic stress at T3 centroids with hydrostatic pore pressure (Terzaghi effective stress in yield). `stages[1]..K` = after each excavation. Each entry has `nodes` (ux,uy) and `element_stresses` (sxx,syy,txy,szz plus in-plane principals s1>=s2 and angle theta1_deg measured CCW from +x to the s1 direction; Smith-Griffiths tension+ sign, same units as E/gamma in .dat). Top-level `nodes` = final cumulative U.
